notes: Mutation anchored on the strongest standard_erasing parent and the baseline_reference prior that minimal/no augmentation dominates in this low-data EuroSAT setting. Keeps only mild crop and flip invariance, slightly relaxes crop probability/magnitude to reduce context loss, and uses rare light erasing as the sole non-geometric regularizer; avoids color jitter and sample mixing because top evidence favors erasing over heavier spectral or mixing perturbations.
